# Million Dollar Funnel™

> Million Dollar Funnel™ (milliondollarfunnels.us) builds done-for-you client acquisition systems for high-ticket service businesses, coaches, consultants, B2B companies and agencies. Each install combines the funnel (landing pages, VSL, application or low-ticket funnels), the follow-up (SMS, email, voicemail drops, AI calling) and the CRM, built, launched and managed by the MDF team so clients never touch the tech.

## What Million Dollar Funnel™ does

- AC Funnels: move prospects from initial interest to application and booked call.
- Landing Pages: focused pages built around one offer and one conversion objective.
- VSL Funnels: video-led selling that educates prospects and moves them toward action.
- Low-Ticket Funnels: sales pages, checkout, order bumps, upsells and downsells that convert cold traffic into buyers.
- Bridge Funnels: warm and pre-frame cold traffic before it reaches the primary offer.
- Application Funnels: collect what sales needs while filtering for better-fit prospects.
- Email & SMS Workflows: automated sequences for new leads, nurturing, reminders, follow-up and reactivation.
- CRM Automation: leads move through the pipeline automatically based on their actions.
- Appointment Workflows: confirmation, reminders, rescheduling and no-show follow-up.
- AI Calling Agent: engages new leads, asks qualifying questions and helps book appointments.
- Paid ads: Meta and Google ads managed alongside the funnel so both are built for each other.

## Who it is for

High-ticket service providers already generating revenue who need a predictable acquisition system instead of referrals: agencies, coaches and consultants, high-ticket service providers, B2B companies, professional services, and information and education businesses. Focus markets: United States, United Kingdom, Canada and Australia.

## How it works

1. Map the offer: who it is for, what it promises and the one action it must cause.
2. Architect the path: the prospect journey, qualification gates and tracking plan.
3. Build the pages: landing, VSL or application structure, mobile-first.
4. Wire the follow-up: A2P-compliant SMS, email, voicemail and AI + human handoff.
5. Launch and compound: live on real traffic, measured daily, optimised weekly.

Most installs are live on real traffic in three to four weeks.
